title: Trump Hiding the Real Death Toll; Why the Saudi Military Can’t Fight; and AI’s Role in Killing Minab Children: The War Brief
author: Murtaza Hussain
content:
In this week's episode of The War Brief Murtaza Hussain and Sarmad discuss the
steady stream of leaks coming out of the War Department, the real number of
deaths among U.S. personnel, the high and ongoing price of war against Iran,
Saudi Arabia potentially turning to Israel for aid, how Ansarallah managed to
shoot down a F-15A fighter jet, and more. Murtaza then discusses why Saudi
Arabia, and the Gulf Arab states, cannot put together an effective fighting
force.
